mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Houston housing price index exceeding 5% indicates weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production above 2% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and inflation expectations, reducing S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures per capita above 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and inflation expectations, reducing S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
